prompt: Yellow calls the big parade downtown
title: Big Parade Downtown
irony: Yellow's race-fast call scatters the march so the big parade only parades when she slows down to walk inside it.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Night street glows under lamps as Yellow lifts her mic on the porch and kids line up with drums.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green hugs his dinosaur book and wants to lead the march, but freezes at the white line.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black shouts a race dare downtown and Yellow calls And they're off as the line surges forward.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole street chants the parade hook, banging drums and stomping past the lamps together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: The kids sprint for the front, Green stalls reading mid-road and Navy hands away flags and sticks.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Yellow calls faster and faster, drums roll, hats fly and the whole parade lands in a laughing heap.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The laughing heap keeps chanting the hook, waving hats and tapping drums from the ground.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Yellow lowers her mic on the porch and sees her race call stopped the march she loves.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Yellow steps into the street with a slow walking call as Green closes his book and takes her hand.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The reunited line slow-marches downtown together, chanting the hook to Yellow's new slow line.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The slow parade waves past the lamps downtown with Yellow marching inside the line at last.
